known_secrets.text: The monument contains at least three distinct construction phases based on tool marks and material composition.
One phase predates known village settlement techniques entirely.
Certain stone joints appear designed to allow controlled partial collapse rather than full stability.
This is not typical of defensive or ceremonial architecture.
Internal alignment patterns do not match surface symmetry.
These patterns suggest intentional internal structuring beneath visible layers.
Some repairs may actually be sealing previously open access points.
I have not informed Tarek of this interpretation.

unknowns: True purpose of the monument system
